The Ghana Scholarships Authority has announced the Ghana allocation, open to Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana, with applications closing on 28 October 2026.

applicant_utility.summary: This is a bilateral-style Saudi government route for Ghanaians: the Ghana Scholarships Authority publishes the notice, but you register and apply yourself on the Ministry of Education's Study in Saudi platform (studyinsaudi.sa), picking one of six universities and one of nine fields. The platform labels its full scholarships as covering tuition, housing and living costs, yet neither the Ghana notice nor the platform publishes a SAR figure for this allocation, so treat visa fees, flights, attestation and personal spending as out-of-pocket until an award letter states the package. Eligibility is narrow and document-based: Ghanaian citizen, resident in Ghana, genuine birth certificate, valid passport. With a 28 October 2026 close only a month after publication, passport checks, certificate attestation and medical clearance need to start the day you read this.
applicant_utility.best_fit: Ghanaian citizens resident in Ghana who hold a valid passport and birth certificate and want a Saudi university placement in business, technology, engineering, medicine, education or architecture.
application_readiness_checklist: Create your account on studyinsaudi.sa and complete the student profile first - the platform marks applications as blocked until the profile is complete

Check passport validity runs well past your intended entry date (platform visa rule: at least 6 months remaining) and that the number you type is correct, because it cannot be changed once an application is submitted
Obtain a medical report proving freedom from infectious diseases
Get your academic certificates attested to the standard the chosen university requires
Confirm your birth certificate particulars match your passport exactly before submitting
Monitor the platform for 'Under Process' status and the institution's admission decision rather than assuming submission equals review
common_rejection_risks: Applying through aggregator or intermediary sites instead of the official studyinsaudi.sa portal named in the notice
Basic data errors after registration - residency number, passport or Gulf ID number, gender and nationality cannot be updated
Applying while holding another scholarship for the same academic degree, which the platform prohibits outright
Not meeting the specific institution's admission requirements - the FAQ states rejections happen when one or more programme or institution admission requirements are unmet
Mismatched or unattested certificates that fail the institution's document checks
applicant_utility.estimated_uncovered_costs: No stipend or tuition figure is published for this allocation, so budget for international flights, visa and residence-permit fees, certificate attestation/apostille, medical reports and personal items until the award letter confirms what is covered.
document_audit: Passport number is permanent after submission - a typo cannot be corrected once you apply
Birth certificate must be genuine and agree with passport name and date of birth
Certificates must be attested per the educational institution's requirements; un-attested documents are a common institution-side rejection cause
A medical report proving freedom from infectious diseases is required for study and for the long-term educational visa
Contact details can be edited after submission, but all other application data cannot
alerts: Deadline is 28 October 2026, only a month after the 28 September 2026 publication - late attestation or passport renewal will kill the application

The platform's own published second-semester 2026 window for international students ended 6 October 2026, before the Ghana deadline - apply via the route in the Ghana notice and confirm with the Ghana Scholarships Authority which intake you are competing for
You cannot hold two scholarships for the same academic degree, so withdraw or defer any existing award before applying

Long-term study visa rules add requirements: age 16 or over, passport with 6+ months validity, medical report, medical insurance and proof of proficiency in the language of study except for Arabic-medium study
Only contact information can be updated after submission - everything else is locked at click-of-submit
applicant_utility.submission_workflow: Register on studyinsaudi.sa, complete the student profile, submit the admission application to your chosen university, then wait for the institution's review and admission decision before the institution and Ministry of Education finalise admission - track status in your platform account.
